tagline: Traditional tartan, with a waterproof layer inside so a wet coat never reaches the filling.
lead: They get raised bolster sides to lean on, and a wet coat stops at the waterproof layer, before the filling.
value: The waterproof layer decides whether a bed survives a muddy winter. It is invisible in a photo, which is why cheaper tartan beds leave it out.
intro: Curlew is a bolster dog bed in traditional tartan upholstery, with raised bolster sides, an internal waterproof layer, leather carry handles and a non-slip base. Medium, Large and XL.
points: A cushioned edge for a chin or a back.
Wet coats and accidents stop before they reach the filling.
For moving the empty bed between rooms, or out to the boot of the car.
It stays put on hard floors.
Traditional, and heavier than printed cotton.
best_for: Dogs who come in wet or muddy, dogs who like a raised edge for their chin or back, and homes with hard floors.
fit_note: The bolsters take up part of the outside footprint. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm. Not sure which size? Ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Follow the sewn-in care label on the cover. The leather handles have their own care instructions. Air-dry fully before use.
seo_title: Tartan Dog Bed with Waterproof Layer & Handles | Snoozly
seo_description: Traditional tartan bolster dog bed with a waterproof inner layer, so wet coats never reach the filling. Leather handles, non-slip base. Medium, Large, XL.
